crossRefs.note: Joshua took Makkedah on that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with its king. He utterly destroyed it and…
There was not a man left in Ai or Bethel who didn’t go out after Israel. They left the city open, and pursued Israel.
He left from there to go to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai…
He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.
The house of Joseph also went up against Bethel, and Yahweh was with them.
